description: This file is a PHPUnit test case class for the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class, testing data retrieval functionalities related to performance tracker logs within the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the PerformanceTrackerLogDao data access object in the OrangeHRM performance plugin.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case with a PerformanceTrackerLogDao instance and loads fixture data.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a performance tracker log by its ID, checking for correct associations and null results.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of logs based on tracker ID, ensuring correct count for existing and non-existing tracker IDs.

methods.name: testGetPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Tests counting positive and negative achievement logs for a specified tracker ID.
